title: 968 灵药谷的开派祖师967 熟悉的修士
content_zh:
968.灵药谷的开派祖师
吕一仁手中那杯酒端在半空，指节微微泛白，杯沿贴着他的下唇却许久没有喝下去，他的目光有些发直，像是透过面前这杯琥珀色的酒液望穿了层层岁月，看到了一片遥远而模糊的土地。
洛豪将他的神情看在眼里，明显看出来了吕一仁的紧张，心中暗自叹了口气，他放下手中的杯子，语气放缓了一些，继续开口，
“你不用担心，我对你没有恶意。我是在正阳大陆北洲飞升的。之前在灵药谷做客时，确实在他们议事堂的正中墙上见过一幅画像，与你一模一样。当时谷主何慧敏告诉我，那是灵药谷的开派祖师，云游四方后再无音讯。我那时并未多想，只当是一位前辈的遗容供奉在那里。没想到今日会在灰苇镇遇见画像上的人。”
吕一仁张了张嘴，声音有些干涩，带着一种连他自己都没有察觉的沙哑，但却带着一丝激动，
“什么？你是正阳大陆飞升的修士？你去过灵药谷吗？灵药谷现在怎么样了？”
“是。”
洛豪点了点头，
“你不用那么着急，坐下来慢慢说吧。”
洛豪说完，他又取出几个杯子，一人倒了一杯用‘云水泉’酿造的酒，同时将酒杯递给了吕一仁。
吕一仁没有再说话，只是垂下眼，将杯中酒一饮而尽，酒液入喉，带着一种温润的暖意，却压不住他心底翻涌的情绪，他的妻子吕小倩在身旁轻轻握住他放在膝上的手，没有说什么安慰的话，只是安静地陪着。
“好酒。”
吕一仁听到洛豪说起灵药谷之后，对洛豪的防备尽去，虽然心中还是激动无比，却能控制住自己没有立即询问，而喝了洛豪的一杯酒后，也忍不住出声赞叹。
过了好一会儿，等自己的心情渐渐的平静下来后，吕一仁这才问了出来，
“洛丹师，不瞒你说，灵药谷是我一手创立的门派。只是不知道我灵药谷现在如何了？我飞升仙界后，就没有找到过灵药谷后面飞升的弟子，这是怎么回事？”
洛豪深呼吸了一口气，然后缓缓开口，
“灵药谷在你飞升之后，是否还有其他人飞升上来，我并不清楚。但我要告诉你的是——至少在数百年之内，你不用指望灵药谷有大批弟子飞升了。如今北洲灵气稀薄，宗门凋零，灵药谷已经是一个五星宗门，修为最高的也不过是玄神境。别说飞升，能修炼到渡劫期的都屈指可数。”
“五星宗门？”
吕一仁抬起头，眼中满是不可置信，
“灵药谷当年在我手中，是堂堂九星大宗门，弟子过万，山门横跨北洲……怎么会……”

他的声音发紧，像是有什么东西堵在喉间，他飞升仙界已经十多万年了，他本以为以灵药谷当年的底蕴，即便自己不在，也至少能维持七八星的规模，弟子一代代飞升上来，终有一日他会在这里等到故人。
可他等了十多万年，一个都没有等到，他一度以为是仙界太大、飞升的地点太分散，所以大家才失散了，可他从未想过，根本原因竟是灵药谷已经衰落到连飞升都成了奢望。
“不单单是灵药谷。”
洛豪补充了一句，语气带着一种旁观者陈述事实的平静，
“整个北洲，最大的宗门也不过是两个八星门派，连一个化仙修士都没有。现在的北洲，已经不是十多万年前的北洲了。”
吕一仁沉默了，他将第二杯酒握在手中，没有再喝，只是静静地看着杯中微微荡漾的酒面，过了好一会儿，他才低声说了一句，
“难怪……难怪我再也等不到灵药谷的弟子了。我一直以为，是他们路上出了什么意外，或者是被别的势力截走了。我从没想过，是他们已经来不了了。”
吕小倩坐在他身侧，一只手始终搭在他的手背上，轻轻摩挲着他的指节，她没有说话，但她的目光始终落在他的侧脸上，像一盏在暗处安静亮着的灯。
又喝了几杯闷酒之后，吕一仁深吸一口气，将那些翻涌的情绪缓缓压回心底，他抬起头看向洛豪时，虽然眼眶还微微泛红，但目光已经重新恢复了清明和沉稳，他放下酒杯，郑重地朝洛豪抱了抱拳，
“洛丹师，今日能在这里遇见一位从正阳大陆飞升上来的同乡，是吕某的缘分。你是从北洲来的，又去过灵药谷，见过那幅画像——这份巧合，在偌大的仙界三十三天里，万中无一。”
content_en:
968. The founder of the Spiritual Medicine Valley
The glass of wine in Lu Yiren's hand was held in the air. His knuckles were slightly white. The rim of the glass was pressed against his lower lip but he had not drank for a long time. His eyes were a little straight, as if he was looking through the layers of time through the amber wine in front of him and saw a distant and vague land.
Luo Hao saw his expression in his eyes and could clearly see Lu Yiren's nervousness. He sighed secretly in his heart. He put down the cup in his hand, his tone slowed down a little, and he continued to speak,
"Don't worry, I have no ill intentions towards you. I ascended in the North Continent of the Zhengyang Continent. When I was a guest in the Spiritual Medicine Valley before, I did see a portrait on the middle wall of their meeting hall, exactly like yours. At that time, the owner of the valley, He Huimin, told me that it was the founder of the sect of the Spiritual Medicine Valley, and he was never heard from again after traveling around. I didn't think much about it at the time, and just thought it was the remains of a senior enshrined there. I didn't expect to meet the person in the portrait in Huiwei Town today."
Lu Yiren opened his mouth, his voice was a little dry, with a hoarseness that even he himself didn't notice, but with a hint of excitement,
"What? Are you an ascended monk from Zhengyang Continent? Have you been to the Spiritual Medicine Valley? How is the Spiritual Medicine Valley doing now?"
"Yes."
Luo Hao nodded,
"You don't have to be so anxious. Sit down and talk slowly."
After Luo Hao finished speaking, he took out a few more cups, each poured a cup of wine brewed from 'Yun Shui Quan', and handed the cup to Lu Yiren at the same time.
Lu Yiren didn't speak any more, he just lowered his eyes and drank the wine in the glass. The liquid went into his throat, with a gentle warmth, but it couldn't suppress the surging emotions in his heart. His wife Lu Xiaoqian was beside him and gently held his hand on his lap. She didn't say any words of comfort, but just stayed with her quietly.
"Good wine."
When Lu Yiren heard Luo Hao talk about the Spiritual Medicine Valley, his guard against Luo Hao disappeared. Although he was still extremely excited, he could control himself from asking immediately. After drinking Luo Hao's glass of wine, he couldn't help but praise him.
After a while, when his mood gradually calmed down, Lu Yiren asked,
"Master Luo Alchemy, to tell you the truth, the Spiritual Medicine Valley is a sect founded by me. I just don't know what's going on with my Spiritual Medicine Valley now? After I ascended to the immortal world, I haven't found the ascended disciples behind the Spiritual Medicine Valley. What's going on?"
Luo Hao took a deep breath, and then slowly spoke,
"I don't know if anyone else has ascended in the Spiritual Medicine Valley after you ascended. But what I want to tell you is that at least within a few hundred years, you don't have to expect a large number of disciples in the Spiritual Medicine Valley to ascend. Nowadays, Beizhou's spiritual energy is thin and the sect has withered. The Spiritual Medicine Valley is already a five-star sect, and the highest cultivation level is only at the Mysterious God Realm. Not to mention ascending, there are only a handful of people who can practice to the stage of transcending the tribulation."
"Five-star sect?"
Lu Yiren raised his head, his eyes full of disbelief.
"The Spiritual Medicine Valley was in my hands back then. It was a powerful nine-star sect with over 10,000 disciples. The sect spanned Beizhou...how could it be..."
His voice was tight, as if something was stuck in his throat. He had ascended to the immortal world for more than 100,000 years. He originally thought that with the foundation of the Spiritual Medicine Valley back then, even if he was not around, he could at least maintain the scale of seven or eight stars. Disciples would ascend from generation to generation, and one day he would meet his old friend here.
But he waited for more than 100,000 years, and no one arrived. He once thought that the fairy world was too big and the places for ascension were too scattered, so everyone was separated. But he never thought that the root cause was that the Spiritual Medicine Valley had declined to the point where even ascension became a luxury.
"It's not just the Spiritual Medicine Valley."
Luo Hao added, his tone was as calm as a bystander stating the facts,
"In the entire Beizhou, the largest sects are only two eight-star sects, and there is not even a single immortal monk. The Beizhou now is no longer the Beizhou more than 100,000 years ago."
Lu Yiren was silent, he willHolding the second glass of wine in his hand, he did not drink any more, but quietly looked at the slightly rippling wine surface in the glass. After a while, he whispered,
"No wonder...no wonder I can no longer wait for the disciples from the Spiritual Medicine Valley. I always thought that something happened to them on the way, or that they were intercepted by other forces. I never thought that they could no longer come."
Lu Xiaoqian sat next to him, one hand always resting on the back of his hand, gently stroking his knuckles. She said nothing, but her eyes always fell on the side of his face, like a quietly burning light in the dark.
After drinking a few more glasses of wine, Lu Yiren took a deep breath and slowly suppressed the surging emotions in his heart. When he raised his head and looked at Luo Hao, although his eyes were still slightly red, his eyes had regained clarity and calmness. He put down the glass and solemnly hugged Luo Hao.
"Master Luo Alchemy, it is Lu's fate that we can meet here today a fellow countryman who ascended from the Zhengyang Continent. You are from Beizhou, you have been to the Spiritual Medicine Valley, and you have seen that portrait - this coincidence is unique in the thirty-three days of the vast immortal world."
